text_block_list.text:
On the way back to Tracen Academy
after doing some shopping outside with Almond Eye—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh?
Over there...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
A lottery, you say!
That sounds fun!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, if it isn't Ai-chan, on a roll lately!
Why not go ahead and snag 1st place in the raffle—the grand prize?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...!
The grand prize from the raffle...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer!
choice_data_list: I've got one raffle ticket right here.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Just one single chance...
Same conditions as a race, then. Sounds good to me!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'm going to go win!

Almond Eye spun the lottery wheel's
crank with immense enthusiasm!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
I won!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Man, impressive as always!
This old man is completely beaten. Here, take it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Take it with me...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: A "Hot Springs Trip Ticket"!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much!
I will gladly accept it.
choice_data_list: (Don't tell me... you completely forgot about the prize...)
(Don't tell me... you completely forgot about the prize, huh...)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Huh, they even have plenty of open-air baths!
It seems like a really splendid hot spring inn!
choice_data_list: Sounds exciting. When are you going?
Sounds exciting. When are you going?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... I have plans on my next day off,
so how about the beginning of next month?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Refreshing ourselves and aiming
for the Osaka Hai sounds great too!
choice_data_list: Got it, I'll add it to the schedule

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"The time you can enjoy hot springs the most
is definitely when you're completely exhausted."
choice_data_list: Alright, let's train a little harder

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's what I wanted to hear! How about you increase your running distance too?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
................
No, you're right. I never did ask, did I?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Do you have a day completely free anytime soon?
choice_data_list: Looks like I'll be busy with courses and stuff for a while.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...On second thought, forget about scheduling the hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Let's put it on hold for now! I'm going to focus on training.
Could you hold onto the travel vouchers for me?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: And that's the end of that story!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Someday—for sure! I'm going!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: First prize...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... What's gotten into Ai-chan?
Wasn't she happy to take 1st place...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer.
1st place means the grand prize, right?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
But... the grand prize is 1st place in the lottery, right?
In that case, I...!
choice_data_list: I didn't lose! Ai didn't lose!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Ah, ummm... Ah, of course!
Ai-chan didn't lose! 1st prize is 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Totally! The "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"
is the greatest honor in history! A summit meant only for Ai-chan!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I did it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Time to eat—!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Mmm~! So tasty!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"The taste of victory... is exquisite!
You should have a bite too, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Second prize...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Aargh, so frustrating!
I was this close to winning...!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what a shame! But hey,
some folks even say this award is the best of all!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Pretty amazing pile of carrots, huh?
They're the greengrocer's top pick—serious carrots!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: A Serious Carrot...!

Wanting them eaten while they're still fresh and tasty—
based on Almond Eye's suggestion,
the academy decided to distribute the carrots as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Carrot.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Are you interested too, Ramonu-san?
Please, go right ahead!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...I shall claim it before long.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Ah!
You haven't taken your carrot yet!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Have some carrots!
They're delicious!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"What an adorable vendor.
Could I have one?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
How do you eat yours, Gentile-san?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I'll have it with some protein.
To gain even greater power—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"To crush the jewel that ought to be crushed.
Ho ho ho..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Ai-senpai, I shall...
take this as well."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
My Make Debut is coming up soon, so...
I'll take some of your strength with me and use it to fuel my run, Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Somehow, it feels like there were a lot of spine-chilling moments...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, oh?
There's a letter in the box.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "One carrot, please"...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Let's go with carrot cake...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Let's eat the leftovers ourselves!
Of course—after training, that is!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I made the board, but...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh!
Damn it...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry about that, kiddo. I shouldn't have egged you on like that...
Now I've got you feeling down over something that has nothing to do with the raffle.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It was so much fun giving it everything as a proper match!
So don't worry, I'm not feeling down at all!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
See you again... next year!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haaah...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: This is...
choice_data_list: I baked them for you. They should be sweet and delicious!
I baked them. They should be sweet and delicious!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Next year, for sure—
I will win!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, a miss...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...I lost, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No, I don't need comforting!
I'm fine, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I just lost the lottery drawing.
I know that full well...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Ghhh,
I know that already~~!!"

Perhaps because she thought of it in terms of winning and losing from the start,
Almond Eye was far more frustrated than necessary.
